race.comment: DEFIANT CODE (17) gets the nod after a debut sixth at Doomben that carried more merit than the finishing position suggests, only beaten 1.3L after closing off strongly from well back. With that race experience and weight relief, he has the right upside profile for a maiden of this shape. KING OF VALHALLA (1) is the more exposed danger, but his record at 1150m is hard to dismiss, with four placings from four tries and a last-start second at this venue when run down late as favourite. SYMO'S BOY (3) resumed with a sound fifth at the on the course proper, only beaten 1.3L at generous odds, and should take benefit from having that run under the belt.
